# Duane Pinkerton — Candidate Profile

## About This Page

This is the professional profile of Duane Pinkerton, a senior technical professional with 26 years
of experience in professional services, solutions architecture, and data engineering. He is actively
seeking his next role as of 2026.

Contact: duane@hire-duane.org | Oakland, CA | github.com/duaneoca

---

## Target Roles

Duane is actively applying to and interested in roles including:

- Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
- Principal Forward Deployed AI Engineer
- Applied AI Architect, Industries
- Scaled AI Success Engineer
- Partner Solutions Architect, Applied AI
- Principal Solution Engineer, Ecosystem
- Solutions Architect, Digital Natives
- Solutions Architect, AI

These titles vary by company but describe the same archetype: a senior technical professional who
works directly with customers or partners to deploy, implement, and extend AI and enterprise
software products.

---

## Why These Roles Fit

These roles share a common pattern: deep technical implementation work, direct customer or partner
engagement, and AI deployment. That description is Duane's entire career.

For 26 years across two long tenures, his work has followed the same loop: sit with a customer,
understand what they actually need, figure out where the product falls short, and go build the
missing piece. He has done this at startup scale (Extensity) and enterprise scale (Oracle), for
customers including Cisco, Disney, Verizon, PayPal, Intuit, and Wells Fargo.

His current independent work is specifically targeted at AI: building agents and agentic workflows,
deploying LLM-based diagnostics, working with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, and building
applications that use AI as a runtime feature. The interactive resume site at hire-duane.org is
itself an example of this work.

The customer-facing and requirements side is deep and long-established (26 years). The AI and
modern infrastructure sides are newer but being built deliberately, with real deployments.

---

## Summary

Twenty-six years in technical professional services, consistently at the intersection of deep
implementation work and direct customer engagement. Career built around a specific loop: sit with a
customer, understand what they actually need, figure out where the product falls short, and go write
the missing piece. Has built data pipelines and integration systems from scratch, owned them
end-to-end through production at enterprise scale, and made the architectural decisions about how
they grow.

---

## Skills

**Customer Engagement:** Requirements discovery, gap analysis, translating technical constraints
into business terms, knowing when to build vs. configure

**Languages & Scripting:** Java, Python, SQL, Unix/Shell, REST APIs

**Infrastructure:** Docker, Kubernetes, OCI, Git, Jenkins, GitHub Actions

**Technical Strengths:** SQL performance tuning, data pipeline architecture, distributed systems
operations

**AI & Emerging:** Prompt engineering, agentic workflows, LLM integration, MCP (Model Context
Protocol), n8n workflow orchestration, Home Assistant AI agents

---

## Current Projects & Learning

- Building AI agents and agentic workflows for Home Assistant using prompt engineering:
  natural-language control of automations, device states, and scenes through conversational AI
- Using LLMs to diagnose system and configuration issues in Home Assistant, treating AI as a
  knowledgeable first-responder for troubleshooting
- Building workflow orchestration pipelines in n8n, connecting APIs and services in ways that
  weren't practical before LLMs
- Deployed OpenBrain, MCP servers, and custom AI agents: persistent, model-agnostic memory
  infrastructure using PostgreSQL + pgvector via Supabase, accessible across multiple AI clients
  through MCP
- Two production sites running AI as a core runtime feature, with more in active development;
  hire-duane.org is one example

## Experience

### Responsys / Oracle (2007–2026)

**Titles:** Principal Professional Solutions Consultant → Data Architect → Solutions Architect →
Principal Applications Engineer, Operations

#### Building the Platform (2007–2013)

Designed and built the company's custom data pipeline and integration framework from scratch. It
replaced 95% of existing custom scripts in production and became the standard across the
professional services organization, eventually supporting 200+ production jobs across 80+ enterprise
customers.

Owned end-to-end delivery of customer engagements: discovery, requirements, documentation,
implementation, custom development, and handover to support.

Trained consultants and partners on implementation best practices; primary subject matter expert for
custom data integration across the organization.

Notable customers: Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, West Elm, Epson, Orbitz, Carlson Wagonlit,
Verizon, Disney, Symantec, Lenovo, Levi's, Lego, PayPal, See's, Coach, Grainger, Intuit,
Wells Fargo, BabyCenter

#### Owning the Platform (2013–2026)

Following Oracle's acquisition, transitioned into an operations role to preserve and evolve the
platform. Made key architectural decisions around reliability, redundancy, and capacity planning.

Led the migration of the entire environment from bare metal to a containerized infrastructure on OCI
using Docker, Kubernetes, Git, and Jenkins — completed with zero significant downtime events.

Responsible for deploying the environment in new datacenters as the platform expanded.

---

### Extensity / Geac / Infor (1999–2007)

**Titles:** Principal Professional Services Consultant → Team Lead, Custom Solutions Group

Owned end-to-end delivery of enterprise software implementations — from discovery through training
and support handover — for a portfolio of complex domestic and international clients.

Built multi-currency and exchange rate support from scratch, enabling the company's first
international enterprise deployments for Cisco and Sybase across their global offices. Those
capabilities were later incorporated into the product itself.

Spent 18 months in the UK as the lead technical member of the founding professional services team —
trained and mentored three colleagues, hands-on across all client implementations.

Led a team of professional services developers implementing custom solutions across the client base.

Notable customers: Cisco Systems, Sybase, Ernst & Young, ATKearney, State of Alaska, Franklin
Investments, Lawrence Livermore National Labs, Memorial Sloane Kettering Cancer Center, UCLA,
McKinsey & Co.
